items.title: 'Everything looked real': How scammers are hijacking your holiday
items.description: Australian travellers are being left out of pocket and fearful their personal data has been stolen, amid growing concerns over the security of online travel bookings.

items.title: Shots fired where gangster's funeral was advertised to be held
items.description: The ABC understands the funeral of Sydney gangster Lorenzo Lemalu was originally scheduled to take place at the venue in Punchbowl, but the plans were changed.

items.title: Diver dies after being bitten by 4.5m shark off Albany, WA
items.description: A male diver has died after an attack by a suspected 4.5-metre shark near Michaelmas Island, off WA's Albany coast, on Saturday morning.

items.title: "We were so close": Laos cave rescue called off as conditions deteriorate
items.description: The search for two men trapped in a flooded cave in Laos has been postponed as rescuers say a "miracle" is needed.

items.title: A Sydney mother died after drinking 67 cups of water under 24-hour watch
items.description: When Tammy Shipley felt herself sliding into psychosis, she made a heartbreaking decision: She walked into a police station and asked to be arrested, believing prison would keep her safe. Here's what happened next.

items.title: How Everest guide survived six days alone with no oxygen and a few chocolates
items.description: A few chocolates found in his pocket and an avalanche may have been what saved Dawa Sherpa from almost certain death on Mount Everest.

items.title: Power hang on for thrilling win over Eagles, Dockers claim record win
items.description: Port Adelaide hangs on for a thrilling win over West Coast after Logan Morris kicked seven in a Brisbane QClash win and Fremantle beat North Melbourne by 124 points to claim the biggest win in its history.

items.title: Broncos' season in crisis as Titans young gun conjures golden moment
items.description: Keano Kini scores one of the great game-winning tries to condemn Brisbane to a fifth-straight defeat, with the Titans snatching a 28-23 victory at Lang Park.

items.title: What's driving Australia's lentil boom?
items.description: Australia's winter crop production is expected to be down this year, but lentils are bucking the trend and headed towards a record.

items.title: Mexico score late winner against sloppy Matildas
items.description: The lacklustre Matildas have been beaten by Mexico for the first time in over 20 years, losing 1-0 in Newcastle.

items.title: Volpato admits he was 'a bit too scared' to make switch from Italy
items.description: New Socceroo Cristian Volpato opens up on his decision to switch allegiance from Italy to Australia ahead of the FIFA World Cup.

items.title: Inflatable frogs and chicken suits: How protests are approaching Trump 2.0
items.description: Demonstrators are increasingly employing inflatable costumes and whimsy. But behind the dress up, these protesters argue it is "serious play".

items.title: Australia, NZ back friendship to endure 'volatile world'
items.description: Global volatility and economic turbulence have dominated annual talks between the leaders of Australia and New Zealand, Anthony Albanese and Christopher Luxon.

items.title: Karen Read sues police for alleged misconduct over boyfriend's death
items.description: After being cleared of allegations she hit her police officer boyfriend and left him to die, Karen Read now claims agencies that investigated the incident were riddled with "bigotry, misogyny [and] systemic failures".

items.title: A dreamy, creamy chicken soup you'll want to eat out of the pot
items.description: Looking for an easy warming meal? This creamy chicken soup has everything you need for a weeknight dinner.

items.title: Mother creates modest activewear to empower herself and others
items.description: Yasmin Jammoul was sick of wearing oversized men's T-shirts to the gym when she started exercising postpartum, so she created her own clothing line.

items.title: Wall Street suffers worst hit of 2026 so far amid massive stock sell-off
items.description: The US stock market has experienced its worst losses in months due to large sell-offs of shares in technology giants and fears of a looming rate hike in the wake of a strong jobs figures report.

items.title: Fastest-rising women's cancer in Australia still has a low profile
items.description: The incidence of uterine cancer has doubled over the past 25 years. But it's also a disease without a public profile, which means many women aren't aware of the warning signs or the risk factors.

items.title: Woman charged with hindering police investigation after man dies at Tweed Heads
items.description: Police have arrested a man and charged a woman after a man died following an alleged assault on the New South Wales North Coast.

items.title: Lorna has lived through two world wars, two pandemics and 26 Australian prime ministers
items.description: After a couple of years as the country's oldest woman, Lorna Henstridge is still going strong.

items.title: Nightmare turnover leaves Wembanyama, Spurs in NBA Finals hole
items.description: Victor Wembanyama turns the ball over and misses two shots in a horror final minute as the Knicks take a 2-0 series lead back to New York.

items.title: Hawks forward target of racist online abuse after loss to Bulldogs
items.description: The AFL and Hawthorn come out in support of Mabior Chol after the Hawks forward shares a series of abusive messages he received after Friday night's match against the Bulldogs.

items.title: Andrew made money subletting cottages on his almost rent-free estate, watchdog finds
items.description: Former prince Andrew pocketed income from cottages on the Windsor estate while living at Royal Lodge under a lease that required virtually no rent, a watchdog report has found.

items.title: New AUKUS risk as Trump orders 'Golden Fleet' battleships
items.description: A committee of Congress wants the US Navy to explain how building "Trump-class" battleships will not delay other nuclear-powered boats, such as submarines needed for AUKUS.

items.title: The US ally getting nuclear-powered submarines with no AUKUS deal
items.description: South Korea is taking a different path to Australia in building nuclear-powered submarines, but its plan still hinges on the United States.
